preregistered_scoring.missing_expected_path_rule: A run receives no retrieval credit if it generates no branch applicable to the frozen retrieval_task. No substitute branch may be selected after examining results.
preregistered_scoring.path_selection_rule: Before relevance judgments, select the branch with the greatest lexical/semantic match to retrieval_task using intent fields and branch title/purpose/query only; ties resolve by branch order. Apply this same target to both systems. If either has no matching branch, record planning failure and no Top-5 metrics for the pair.
preregistered_scoring.retrieval: Top 5 are OpenAlex API raw ranks in the preselected branch; common production retrieval and ranking code is used without result-side sorting changes.
preregistered_scoring.relevance: 0 irrelevant, 1 partially relevant, 2 highly relevant. P@5 threshold is >=1. nDCG gain is 2^label-1; rank discount log2(rank+1).
preregistered_scoring.pairing: Same exact original query; same OpenAlex source, per-branch count=5, existing abstract filter, exact duplicate query cache shared; distinct queries always fetched independently.
